question: What does the application answer on an address that no endpoint matches (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, authenticated and anonymous), incl. fallbacks, FallbackPolicy, existing 404/405 tests, and non-guid constraint behaviour?
claim: Statically, no fallback, catch-all, static-file, SPA, status-code-pages or 404-rewriting middleware and no FallbackPolicy/DefaultPolicy exist in the Bootstrapper or Shared.Infrastructure, so an unmatched address passes through the pipeline with no endpoint selected and, by ASP.NET Core default behaviour (framework behaviour, not read in repo code), would end as an empty 404 for any method and for both authenticated and anonymous callers. The pipeline order is: ForwardedHeaders, Cors, CorrelationId, ErrorHandling (try/catch of exceptions only), Swagger, SwaggerUI (/swagger), ReDoc (/docs), Authentication, Context, Logging, Routing, Authorization, then module Use, then MapGet /, /ping, /modules, module Expose. No existing integration test asserts the status for a non-existent address, for 405, or for GET /resources/types/not-a-guid. The 404 tests that exist hit existing endpoints and get 404 from a domain exception mapped to NotFound. The actual HTTP status was not exercised, so it is determined only from the code plus framework defaults.
